content:
Kira (CS): Quick sync — Brightline is at ~93% of monthly token quota and we're starting to see 429s crop up as they hit bursty spikes. Can we coordinate a proactive comms + short-term quota bump? cc @Marta (AE) @Sam (SRE) :eyes:

Marta (AE): Thanks — I can own the outreach. Draft message suggestion: explain temporary bump, ask them to stagger heavy batch jobs, offer a 30-minute ops call. Want SRE numbers to include in the note. :+1:

Sam (SRE): Metrics from infra: peak token rate jumped around 03:12 UTC. Quick query I ran:

```
sum(rate(api.tokens_consumed[5m])) by (customer)
| filter customer = "brightline"
| last(1h)
```

5m peak ~190k tokens/min (baseline ~120k). Error rate (429+5xx) up to 3.4% in last 30m. P50 latency rose from 210ms -> 380ms during spikes. Suggest: temporary quota bump to 120% for 24h, enable a softer token backlog limiter (grace window), and a reminder to customer about client-side retry/backoff.

Diego (Solutions): I can send a small client-side snippet for retry/backoff + suggest a batching tweak. Suggested changes we can share in the email:

- set max_batch_tokens=2048
- use exponential backoff with jitter on 429s (start 300ms, max 10s)

Example snippet (JS):
```js
// pseudo
client.defaults({ maxBatchTokens: 2048 });
await retry(async () => client.generate(...), { minDelay: 300, maxDelay: 10000, jitter: true });
```

Marta (AE): Great. I'll include Diego's snippet and Sam's metrics. Proposed outreach timeline: send email now notifying of planned 24h bump and advise to apply retries; follow-up 24 hours later with usage summary and recommendations. Who will submit request to provisioning?

Kira (CS): I can file the provisioning request, but prefer ops-bot to do it so we have a ticket. @notify-bot can you raise the quota bump request: customer=brightline, delta=+20%, duration=24h, reason=high bursty traffic + avoid 429s?

notify-bot: Quota bump request submitted. Ticket #4578 created, routing to Provisioning. Estimated apply time: ~12 minutes. :gear:

Sam (SRE): I'll watch infra and post an update once the bump is applied. If error rate doesn't drop within 30m post-bump, we should schedule a brief ops call and consider a temporary canary routing to a higher-capacity pool.

Marta (AE): I'll send the email now (copying Diego's snippet + Sam's metrics) and note the ticket #4578. Wording: short, factual, include recommended client changes and offer a 30-min troubleshooting window.

Kira (CS): Perfect. Post here when ticket moves to "applied" and once email is sent. Thanks everyone. :v
